Inference API Reference¶

The hypothesis tests of PlussMa live in pluss::subsp::stats::inference::hypothesis. Every test is a free function that takes the data as Series, an options struct, and an optional Config, and returns a result struct that extends TestDecision.

The Result¶

Field

Meaning

stat

the test statistic

pvalue

the probability, if the null hypothesis is true, of a statistic at least as extreme as the observed one

critical

the critical value of the statistic at level alpha

reject

true when pvalue < alpha

Each test adds its own fields (degrees of freedom, means, standard errors, an interval, the number of observations used). Missing and non-finite values are dropped, and the effective_n fields say how many observations remained.

The Options¶

TestOptions has alpha (default 0.05), tail (Tail::Both, Tail::Right or Tail::Left) and method (PValueMethod::Auto, Exact or Approximate, for the tests that have an exact and an approximate p-value). ttest2 takes TTest2Options (alpha, tail, equal_variance), anova_1w takes Anova1WOptions and chisq_gof takes ChiGofOptions. The examples use namespace hyp = pluss::subsp::stats::inference::hypothesis;.

The Functions¶

Group

Functions

What they cover

Means and variances

7

Tests of means (one sample, paired, two samples), of a mean with known spread, and of variances.

Ranks and signs

3

Tests that use ranks or signs: the rank-sum, signed-rank and sign tests.

Distributions

3

Tests of a whole distribution: Kolmogorov–Smirnov (one and two samples) and Jarque–Bera.

Groups and tables

3

Analysis of variance for several groups, and chi-squared tests for counts and tables.

For the tests of time series (unit roots, stationarity, ARCH effects, forecast comparison) see the time-series reference.
